Featuring colorful costumes, a live rock band, and powerhouse vocalists, Rockin' Rewind includes favorites like "I Gotta Feeling," "RESPECT," "Hello," "Imagine," "Let It Be," "Old Time Rock and Roll," "Play That Funky Music," "How Deep Is Your Love," "Joy to the World," "Happy," "Don't Stop Believin'," and "Celebration," with music made famous by the Black Eyed Peas, Whitney Houston, Journey, The Beatles, The 5th Dimension, Chubby Checker, and more.

shows.name: Country Duos
shows.info: Celebrate the music of four of country's biggest stars and most iconic couples?Tim McGraw, Faith Hill, Garth Brooks, and Trisha Yearwood. This unforgettable show features hit songs including "She's in Love with the Boy," "Just to See You Smile," "Live Like You Were Dying," "The Song Remembers When," "Friends in Low Places," "Shameless," "Ain't Goin' Down ('Til the Sun Comes Up)," "There You'll Be," "Breathe," and many more!

shows.name: That'll Be The Day: A Tribute to Buddy Holly
shows.info: In THAT'LL BE THE DAY, Todd Meredith and The Rave-Ons will take you on a musical journey starting with Buddy's early recordings through his breakout hits. Audience members will be treated to humorous banter and music history trivia inspired by this influential group. This performance gives a fresh take on the catalog of Buddy Holly & The Crickets, featuring all the band's hits as well as some lesser known gems. Buddy is a true music pioneer and is considered by many to be the Father of Rock & Roll. Don't miss this exceptional tribute!
